objective: Fit a sender using atomic operations on public wiring and anonymous groups of switches; freeze it with the previous decoder and measure delayed correctness and minimum physical message width after rewiring all inputs, with strict one-switch and all-answers controls.
status: Both frozen group-capable senders reduced six bits to four on eight new coordination cases and the earlier nine-bit case to four. Each answered all 196,608 delayed questions and reached 80/96 unrestricted minima. A zero-training exchange of the learned tracing rules reached 92/96, including all 18 nuisance cases. Four parity-dependent wirings need a stronger receiver to reach three.
title: Learn to trace sources and switch groups of questions to computed answers
